import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivision

/-!
# The barycentric subdivision chain map on vertex lists

The recursive barycentric subdivision of ordered vertex lists commutes with
the boundary. In degree one the two barycenter endpoints cancel; in higher
degrees the cone boundary identity and the induction hypothesis give the result.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Barycentric subdivision commutes with the vertex-list boundary. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivision_comm (m n : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1) ≫
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n =
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 1) n ≫
        barycentricSubdivision m n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivision_succ_assoc]
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ _ ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _ ≫ 𝟙 _
      simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
      rw [← Category.assoc (vertexListChain v), vertexListChain_boundary]
      simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.zsmul_comp,
        vertexListChain_cone_assoc, vertexListChain_boundary]
      have hzero (w : Fin 1 → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
          Fin.cons (affineSimplexBarycenter v) w ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove = w := by
        funext i
        simp
      have hone (w : Fin 1 → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
          Fin.cons (affineSimplexBarycenter v) w ∘ (1 : Fin 2).succAbove =
            fun _ : Fin 1 => affineSimplexBarycenter v := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        rfl
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, Fin.sum_univ_two, hzero, hone, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero,
        one_smul, Fin.val_one, pow_one, neg_one_smul]
      abel
  | succ n ih =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivision_succ_assoc]
      rw [vertexListCone_boundary]
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision m (n + 1)), ih]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc
        ((VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d (n + 2) (n + 1)),
        (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).d_comp_d]
      simp

/-- Barycentric subdivision as an endomorphism of the vertex-list chain complex. -/
def barycentricSubdivisionChainMap (m : ℕ) :
    VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) ⟶
      VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :=
  ChainComplex.ofHom (barycentricSubdivision m) (barycentricSubdivision_comm m)

end Mumford.Analytic
